items.exampleEn: The emphasis of this course is on speaking.
Electronic books are lighter than paper ones.
There are over a hundred channels on our TV.
items.exampleZh: 我們的電視有一百多個頻道。
她的簡報進行了二十分鐘。

items.exampleEn: Waving your hand is a common gesture.
The morning edition of the newspaper arrives at six.
items.exampleZh: 報紙的早上版六點送到。

items.sentenceEn: Engineering is a popular subject at our school.
items.sentenceZh: 工程在我們學校是熱門科目。

items.audioEn: Our presentation will start late because the room is not ready.
items.audioZh: 我們的簡報會晚點開始，因為場地還沒準備好。
options: The speaker's train is running late.

items.sentenceEn: Turn on the news channel, please.
He made a small gesture with his hand.
items.sentenceZh: 他用手做了一個小手勢。

items.stemEn: Which ____ is the football game on tonight?
items.stemZh: 今晚的足球賽在哪個頻道播？

items.stemEn: The music was so ____ that my ears hurt.
items.stemZh: 音樂大聲到我的耳朵都痛了。

items.passageEn: Last week, my sister gave a presentation about engineering at her school. She talked about how electronic toys are made, and she showed a graph of how many toys break every year. She put special emphasis on safety. She used many hand gestures, and her voice was loud and clear. Her teacher said it was good enough for a TV channel for students. After class, she bought the new edition of her favorite science magazine.
items.passageZh: 上週，我姊姊在學校做了一場關於工程的簡報。她講電子玩具是怎麼做出來的，還用一張圖表說明每年有多少玩具壞掉。她特別強調安全。她用了很多手勢，聲音又大又清楚。老師說她的簡報好到可以在給學生看的頻道上播出。下課後，她買了最喜歡的科學雜誌新的一期。

options: 一台新的電子玩具機器人
一本關於工程的厚重教科書

items.promptZh: 我爸爸喜歡收集舊的電子產品。
referenceEn: My father likes to collect old electronic products.
My dad likes collecting old electronic products.
rubricZh: electronic 表示「電子的」，放在名詞前，例如 electronic products 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說習慣用現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 edition 造一個句子，說說你有或想買的某本書或雜誌的版本。
referenceEn: I have the first edition of my favorite comic book.
I want to buy the new edition of this dictionary.
rubricZh: edition 表示「版、版本」，例如 the first edition、the new edition 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
